comment: priest.c move_special() chooses a square that mfndpos() marked ALLOW_M and calls monmove.c m_move_aggress() for it. mon.c mm_2way_aggression() marks a zombie next to the human temple priest that way. The hero level-teleports to Minetown in wizard mode, maps it with ^F, travels to the altar (killing two gnomes that block the way), and creates three kobold zombies. While the hero searches with the m prefix, the priest of Odin swings his mace at the zombies from pri_move() and destroys them.
